stories.title: Newcomer
stories.author: ‘Pemi Aguda
stories.description: A small Pentecostal church rejoices when a visitor comes back for a second Sunday. The longer she keeps returning, the harder it gets for the congregation to agree on what welcoming her means.

stories.title: Little Free Library
stories.author: Naomi Kritzer
stories.description: Meigan builds a book exchange outside her house. Then a borrower starts leaving gifts that make no sense, until a letter arrives with a request she could never have anticipated.

stories.title: The Cleaner
stories.author: Emma Vescovo
stories.description: Danny cleans a house after a medical emergency. When he runs into the woman who watched him work, their quiet conversation takes them out into a Chicago winter.

stories.title: My Country Is a Ghost
stories.author: Eugenia Triantafyllou
stories.description: At the border, Niovi has to give up the necklace that houses her mother’s ghost. Starting over in a new country means figuring out what grief looks like when the dead can’t come with you.

stories.title: Grocery Store Mama
stories.author: Shayla Frandsen
stories.description: A woman opens a grocery store with her tiger-obsessed grandmother behind the register. The two have very different ideas about what a store owes the people who walk through its doors.

stories.title: Headland
stories.author: Harry Goddard
stories.description: Two boys set out to see a dead whale washed up on the rocks. One is limping after a punishment the other escaped, and neither knows how to talk about it.

stories.title: Day Ten Thousand
stories.author: Isabel J. Kim
stories.description: A man in prehistory learns exactly how he’ll die and that, ten thousand years later, strangers will give him a name. The story keeps both times in view as he decides what to do with that knowledge.

stories.title: Udara Juice
stories.author: Ada Nnadi
stories.description: Justina marries Felicity on her husband’s behalf. Inside a household that has already decided what each woman is there for, the two begin to make room for one another.

stories.title: Selkie Stories Are for Losers
stories.author: Sofia Samatar
stories.description: A young restaurant worker keeps telling us how much she hates selkie stories. Between shifts and a growing friendship, she comes closer to telling the one that matters to her.

stories.title: A Bedtime Story
stories.author: Gideon Jacobs
stories.description: When sleep won’t come, Nancy pays a celebrity to tell her a bedtime story. The actual Cameo videos are part of this odd, funny story about wanting someone to talk you through the night.

stories.title: Child of the Soil
stories.author: Michael Emehinola
stories.description: A missionary gives Kwame a new name. As drought settles over the village, his grandmother tries to bring back what the boy has been taught to give up.

stories.title: The Perfect Match
stories.author: Ken Liu
stories.description: Sai’s digital assistant knows what he wants before he does. Then a neighbor asks how he can tell which wants were his in the first place.

stories.title: Between Chamisa and Rengyō
stories.author: Mizuki Yamamoto
stories.description: In the Sangre de Cristo mountains, the smell of rain sends a narrator back to Japan. The flowers of two landscapes give shape to a memory that proves harder to share than to summon.

stories.title: Field Marks
stories.author: Nerissa Nelson
stories.description: Bird illustrations keep disappearing from valuable field guides. A methodical investigation into the missing pages begins to resemble a different kind of search.

stories.title: Inventory
stories.author: Carmen Maria Machado
stories.description: A woman catalogues her lovers as an epidemic closes in. Each encounter carries a little more of the world she’s trying to remember.

stories.title: Forty-Nine Roses
stories.author: CJ Julisch
stories.description: At a funeral, a mourner counts the flowers and tries to follow the script their sister rehearsed with them. The hardest part is working out when the people offering comfort actually want an answer.

stories.title: Rabbit
stories.author: Jonathan Aprea
stories.description: After weeks of barely leaving the house, a former mall employee gets invited to a Matrix-themed party. It calls up the memory of a teenage coworker whose Easter Bunny costume made him hard to miss and easy to overlook.

stories.title: The Talking Dog
stories.author: Jamie Mullins
stories.description: A brother plays a video of a dog that can ask to go outside. On the television, a man stands in the rubble of a school. This short piece makes the distance between the two screens feel unbearable.
